title: [finding] os migrate meta aborts at load on an object built with ObjectSchema.create that carries a retired key, although the refusal it prints tells the author to run os migrate meta
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with a measured `reach:`**, class **(a)**. Filed by the `domain:cli` execution seat (#6024, session `local_1d2a197c-c20e-4e90-9be8-413d4d432289`) from the #20620 dev's report on PR #20691. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens (measured at `6981abfd26`)

`os migrate meta --from 17` exits 1 at load with a raw `ZodError` array (`unrecognized_keys`, `tenancy.organizationField`) on a stack whose object is built with `ObjectSchema.create(...)` and carries a retired key. The refusal's own message prescribes "Run `os migrate meta --from 17` to list the mechanical edits…", so the command it names refuses the same stack before its chain runs.

- **Repro:** `defineStack({ objects: [ObjectSchema.create({ name: 'cr_ticket', label: 'Ticket', fields: { title: { type: 'text', label: 'Title' } }, tenancy: { enabled: true, organizationField: 'organization_id' } })] })` gives exit 1 with `unrecognized_keys tenancy.organizationField`.
- **Control:** the same object as a plain literal loads, the conversion `object-tenancy-organization-field-removed` applies, and `schemaValid` is `true`.
- **The mechanism the dev read:** the authored-source shim in `packages/cli/src/utils/config.ts` (`DEFINE_HELPER_RE = /^define[A-Z]/`) wraps only `define*` exports. `ObjectSchema.create` validates strictly at the call, before the migration chain can convert anything.
- **`reach:`** the public door `os migrate meta`. The named producers are 35 `ObjectSchema.create(` sites across `examples/` (`app-crm`, `app-showcase`) and HotCRM (`src/sales/objects/account.object.ts` at hotcrm `087b7c5d`). Any of them that carries a key retired at a step the author upgrades across cannot be migrated by the tool the refusal names.

## Not decided here

Whether the fix belongs in the shim (wrap `ObjectSchema.create` too), in `ObjectSchema.create` (defer to the chain the way `defineStack` does), or in the refusal text is triage's routing and the owning seat's design. This card only records the defect and its reach.

## Dedupe

A search of this repository for `ObjectSchema.create migrate meta`, `authored-source shim ObjectSchema.create`, `DEFINE_HELPER_RE` and `migrate meta load unrecognized_keys` finds only #20620 and PR #20691, where this was found, and closed cards about individual retirements. No card carries this defect.

Dedupe words: `authored-source shim ObjectSchema.create` · `migrate meta load abort retired key` · `defineHelpersOf DEFINE_HELPER_RE` · `tombstone prescribes migrate meta that refuses`
